title: Research sprint goal: The open gaps of the agents, claude, mcp, prior-art and python articles are researched against the census
goal: The sprint goal's open questions are answered with the kb tools first and the live docs for the gaps, and the findings are written as kb facts and gap entries through the kb skills, so each committed item can name the knowledge it needs. Tested rows for kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv are a code-lane path (_tools/kblane.py): a story finished with them lands through backlog.py land ID --wait-merge SECONDS, not done --commit.
notes: 2026-10-20 planning: the sprint's items are research items themselves; this story only settles what they share before the first is claimed: the routes kb_pack gives for their topics after the census, and the live docs servers each needs (claude-code-docs, mcp-docs, the web for prior-art and python). It waits for the census tag ST-ywqj4gva. 2026-10-21 findings. (1) Open gaps per sibling premises: 24 agents/a, 43 agents/c-d, 30 agents/e-w, 60 claude/mcp/prior-art/no topic, 43 python: 200, none with a note dated 2026-10-21. claude holds 6 partial articles (ci-and-headless 12 gaps, settings-and-scopes 9), mcp 12, prior-art 8, python 26. (2) Routes: kb_pack on a sampled gap question of each group gives coverage good with the owning article and the gap's UNK line. One miss: the MCP tool-annotation question returned agents/subagents-vs-deterministic-tools, not mcp/tools, so read an mcp gap's own article with rag.py show too. (3) Live docs: claude-code-docs and mcp-docs answer without authentication, but one search returns 60 to 150 thousand characters, saved to a file: read it with jq or python, or query_docs_filesystem with head on a result's .mdx path. For python, WebSearch on a uv query gave only secondary pages: pass allowed_domains (docs.astral.sh, docs.python.org) or WebFetch the official page; prior-art gaps use WebFetch of the tool's own site or pinned raw file. Learn is not needed. No outside facts: the questions were about this repository's pack routes, the ledger and which live servers answer here; no fact about an outside source was learned.
